heading: INT. LUNAR ICE-MINING HABITAT - AIRLOCK BAY - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. LUNAR ICE-MINING HABITAT - AIRLOCK BAY - CONTINUOUS
Dim sodium lamps.
Racked suits hanging like hanged men.
Frost creeping up the inner hatch.
Two figures prepare for a walk.

TECHNICIAN ADEBAYO KOWALSKI-NAKAMURA (40s, undersuit, cooling garment tubing coiled at his neck) checks the seal on his glove while his partner, WARRANT OFFICER INGRID SOLBERG-MWANGI (30s, shaved head, flight patch on her sleeve) tests a tether clip, tugs it twice, and clips it to his belt, then runs a gloved thumb along the seam of his helmet ring.
Pressure.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Four-seven. Holding.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: Ninety-eight percent.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: She nods.
He nods.
Neither speaks for a moment, and he picks up a sample case, hefts it, and sets it back down.
She turns the dial on the wall panel, and the inner hatch slides shut with a hiss.
Last time, you said you saw a light in the crater.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: I saw a reflection.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: You said light.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Ingrid, it was nothing.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: She regards him through her visor.
He looks at the floor.
The pumps hum, drawing the air out of the bay, and the frost on the hatch deepens.
Then we go look at nothing.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: The outer door shudders open onto the black.
He steps through first.
She follows, paying out the tether behind her.
